sentences.sentZh: 挂在最下面的小猴子伸手去捞月亮。他的手刚碰到水，月亮就不见了。

sentences.sentEn: The little monkey hanging at the very bottom reached out to scoop up the moon. The moment his hand touched the water, the moon disappeared.
